_README: Drop sources derived from the CLIENT'S OWN XML for items that state no source directly. Nothing here was scraped: realmeye.com/robots.txt disallows Claude-Code, and the only RealmEye data in this project is the single page capture in realmeye-untiered-by-dungeon.tsv. Each entry below was produced by one agent reading the 246 local XML files and then had to survive TWO independent adversarial refuters, both instructed to default to refuted. 107 claims were made; 26 were killed outright, 14 split 1-1 and were discarded, 67 survived. The `evidence` field is the exact quoted local text - check any of them.

MV Intermediate Fishing Rod.evidence: Definitive, two ways. L2 equip.xml `<Object id="MV Intermediate Fishing Rod" type="0x50f2">`: `<EffectInfo description="Only usable in the Moonlight Village. Aim at ripples in the water to catch fish!" name="Fishing" />` (attribute order is description-first here — parsed as a dict, not positionally). L1/sprite-sheet: same block carries `<Texture><File>moonlightVillageObjects8x8</File><Index>487</Index></Texture>`, a dungeon-specific sheet. Its thrown bait `<OnPlayerShootActivate … objectId="MV Intermediate Bait" …>ObjectToss</OnPlayerShootActivate>` is likewise MV-prefixed.
